name: Osher AI
description: Celo-native savings agent for MiniPay and MetaMask users. Osher creates savings goals, checks wallet balances, prepares wallet-approved USDT vault top-ups, generates nudges and tips, and exposes savings-agent APIs for other builders and agents.

skills.name: Celo Savings Coach
skills.description: Understands savings requests, creates goal plans, and gives contextual savings guidance.

skills.name: Wallet Balance Check
skills.description: Checks Celo wallet balances for CELO and supported stablecoins.

skills.name: Vault Deposit Intent
skills.description: Prepares user-approved USDT vault top-up instructions for savings goals.

skills.name: Developer Infrastructure
skills.description: Provides APIs for goal parsing, savings plans, nudges, tips, context summaries, and vault deposit intents.
